## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Member Articles
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100528

## Settings Documentation for Streaming Member Articles
This document provides detailed descriptions of the settings available for configuring the Streaming Member Articles section on the platform. Each setting allows for customization to meet specific needs and preferences.
To edit these settings, navigate to:
In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings
Select Designs Settings
Open The Homepage Tab
Open The Module Select Content to Display
Select The Streaming Member Articles section
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145466917/original/7Qb5o3WH5FvyRc9Mk4F2VRiCW9B5z14WFg.png?1719439241 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145466918/original/Fwbg1qcfbaibk3bHBE6eB9d-AeXjFFM-VQ.png?1719439241 | alt: ]

## Visual Guide of the  Streaming Member Articles
These are the available settings for the Streaming Member Articles section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145467510/original/vwzsMh-gFLetNO33-t_F-mYe6H7o5fMq9w.png?1719439951 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145467512/original/jm2xrXHFsQaomFMTFBQU0riYFYVFf0iqew.png?1719439958 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145467513/original/NHasTd32Z-zJ6beKqHTtyamhhr9BxrWTkA.png?1719439970 | alt: ]

## 1. Recent Member Articles Title
This setting allows the Admin to set the title for the recent member articles section. The title can be customized by entering the desired text in the provided input field.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145467645/original/W5ZPoTJF0ks4d-uV5cdRaSElKaDiChGCBg.png?1719440191 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145467813/original/Kkw_iGk_p8QxdRQZb52tPU7E30r-SDzjIg.png?1719440480 | alt: ]

## 2. Title Color
The title color setting enables the customization of the title's color. Admins can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145467897/original/oEUdeGKrUrXGjz9GDzFqx0rkGMn5QsxUHw.png?1719440540 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468079/original/lnocfYQkqtiss8zzZLbBYC0MfLg4x0Xk5A.png?1719440721 | alt: ]

## 3. Display Options
This setting controls the number of recent member articles displayed. Admins can select from a range of options, from 1 to 24 results. Additionally, the layout can be adjusted to show a specific number of results per row, ranging from 2 to 4 results per row.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468197/original/Ra1wN5GHCbimH_EKFr_uNnxqNRilLlICdQ.png?1719441090 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468079/original/lnocfYQkqtiss8zzZLbBYC0MfLg4x0Xk5A.png?1719440721 | alt: ]

## 4. Enable Carousel Slider
The carousel slider option allows recent member articles to be displayed in a sliding carousel format. This can be toggled on or off using the provided dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468205/original/D8iQZHJs4r9uHmmb0H53cYTHVLHIkLr10w.png?1719441110 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468079/original/lnocfYQkqtiss8zzZLbBYC0MfLg4x0Xk5A.png?1719440721 | alt: ]

## 5. Hide On Mobile
This setting allows Admins to choose whether the recent member articles section should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468215/original/zTyTEapHXAAiucjfeULTWLIwpIh_vIS93g.png?1719441160 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468250/original/xM-FJ4HP_Tiiv8Jd1KpxOa_KfP-6cgUUDw.png?1719441215 | alt: ]

## 6. Linked Post Type
This setting allows the Admin to select the type of content linked to the recent member articles. Options include events, job listings, coupons, videos, audio posts, website blog articles, community articles, and discussions.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468294/original/EQrTyz8clO7p6vUvN1VsRgLDTWqQV8PMlw.png?1719441280 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468079/original/lnocfYQkqtiss8zzZLbBYC0MfLg4x0Xk5A.png?1719440721 | alt: ]

## 7. Only Show Posts with Photos
Admins can choose to display only those posts that have photos. This setting ensures that posts without photos are excluded from the recent member articles list.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468311/original/DuSLPeRzdPH0NhRHEsQ4xSNwVdlB9cEdGA.png?1719441337 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468079/original/lnocfYQkqtiss8zzZLbBYC0MfLg4x0Xk5A.png?1719440721 | alt: ]

## 8. Image Quality
This setting controls the quality of the images displayed in the recent member articles. Admins can choose between thumbnail size and large size.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468347/original/j0N5WHOy3UhsKBtt0vrNIbiy-P7u5LzPmQ.png?1719441383 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468079/original/lnocfYQkqtiss8zzZLbBYC0MfLg4x0Xk5A.png?1719440721 | alt: ]

## 9. Show "View All" Button
The "View All" button allows users to see all recent member articles. This setting can be toggled on or off using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468359/original/ZR363YbAxFt2tz2qlGVxLaWN6fQqU0iIvw.png?1719441441 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468393/original/_a9DHMBqbEikAvcomWNwqMRBJYbdm0TdWQ.png?1719441481 | alt: ]

## 10. Hide If No Posts Exist
This setting allows Admins to choose whether the recent member articles section should be hidden if no posts exist. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468404/original/jq4RHfGqrEGdqG51Q3kg82HDMK0Q-JhrIg.png?1719441536 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468407/original/UfHF_PTwyyBX_lgbKl3csigiexgjx-P21Q.png?1719441548 | alt: ]

## 11. Only Include Posts from Active Members
This setting specifies whether only posts from active members should be included. Admins can choose to include posts from active members only or from all members.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468423/original/cpIQqvuPb1KOhiYxxwG3KCol_AQhcGOjdQ.png?1719441635 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468407/original/UfHF_PTwyyBX_lgbKl3csigiexgjx-P21Q.png?1719441548 | alt: ]

## 12. Include Posts from Non-Searchable Members
This setting allows Admins to choose whether to include posts from non-searchable members. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468441/original/zyNt_93mdF1HOy6SYlFjGatU8ih1EFZDWQ.png?1719441704 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468407/original/UfHF_PTwyyBX_lgbKl3csigiexgjx-P21Q.png?1719441548 | alt: ]

## 13. Include Posts from Members in These Plans
This setting allows Admins to limit the displayed posts to specific membership plans. Admins can select the desired membership plans from the provided list.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468452/original/Cl6k2-hnbQQASIOm-3Ojxfy-QWZcWSX-_w.png?1719441767 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468407/original/UfHF_PTwyyBX_lgbKl3csigiexgjx-P21Q.png?1719441548 | alt: ]

## 14. Display Order
The display order setting determines the order in which recent member articles are shown. Options include newest first, oldest first, or random order. This can be customized by selecting the desired option from the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468461/original/SYTX8gC6kbySl8rIaKZSIAfAu-ezgi9QUg.png?1719441821 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468407/original/UfHF_PTwyyBX_lgbKl3csigiexgjx-P21Q.png?1719441548 | alt: ]

## 15. Limit One Post per Member?
This setting specifies whether only one post per member should be displayed. Admins can choose to display one post per member or allow multiple posts from the same member.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468474/original/JzikfDZWb9ipLBEf8vAdxNcHFSbs_3IKeA.png?1719441918 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145468407/original/UfHF_PTwyyBX_lgbKl3csigiexgjx-P21Q.png?1719441548 | alt: ]
